message.reasoning:
The user says (in Polish): "stwórz w css kartę która będzie się obracać po najechaniu kursorem". That translates to: "create a CSS card that will rotate on hover with the cursor." So they want code for a rotating card effect using CSS. They didn't ask for anything else. We should provide an example of HTML/CSS that creates a card that rotates when hovered over.

We can give a simple example: a container div with perspective, inner card with transform-style preserve-3d, front and back faces. On hover, rotate Y axis. Provide CSS and minimal HTML. Also maybe mention that you need to set perspective on parent. Provide explanation.

Thus answer: Provide code snippet. No tool calls needed.
